Description: Enable students to find and host campus events
Acceptance Criteria: Search filter RSVP and create events work end to end

Description: As a student I want to search and filter events so I can find something relevant
Acceptance Criteria: Category and text filters update results

Description: As a student I want to RSVP so the organiser can track attendance
Acceptance Criteria: RSVP increments attendance and blocks a full event

Description: As an organiser I want to publish an event so students can discover it
Acceptance Criteria: Valid form creates a persisted event

Description: As a contributor I want automated checks so changes are safer
Acceptance Criteria: Pull requests run syntax checks and API tests

Description: As an operator I want health and metrics endpoints so I can monitor the API
Document Compose startup and demo credentials
